test_activation_simplifier: test the activation_simplifier detects softplus, softmax, relu, leaky_relu, sigmoid, and clip primitives in JaxPR graphs
test_expand_softmax_simplifier: test the expand_softmax_simplifier decomposes softmax into exp, reduce_sum, broadcast_in_dim, posreciprocal, and mul primitives
test_group_linear_sequence: test the group_linear_sequence simplifier detects and groups linear operations like dot_general, add, reduce_sum, div, and sub into a linear primitive
test_fused_relu_simplifier: test the fused_relu_simplifier detects and groups relu applied after a linear layer into a single fused_relu primitive
test_default_simplifier: test the default_simplifier composes activation_simplifier, replace_eltwise_minimum, replace_eltwise_maximum, hoist_constant_computations, group_linear_sequence, and group_posbilinear
